services.name: Sunset Paddle Cruise
services.desc: This class is best for paddlers with some experience. Join us for our longest standing event, the beautiful sunset paddle on the waters of Marina del Rey. This easy moving paddle will give you the opportunity to enjoy the marina at sunset and help melt the day away. We will have a 60-75 minute paddle. Please arrive on time, late arrivals may miss the session and are not eligible for refund. Arrive no later than 6:15pm. We will get on the water at 6:30pm Price: $35.00 DISCLAIMER: We need a minimum of four reservations for this event to happen. If the group is too small, reservations will have the option to be refunded or rescheduled. Thank you. Photos Courtesy Kirill

services.desc: Explore the calm waters of the marina with us on our guided tour. Time: 10:00am. Monday to Sunday You'll choose a single or double kayak for this activity. Paddle-boarding is available with experience. services.name: Discount Rental Passes
services.desc: Get ready to save big on all your kayak and paddleboard adventures with Pro SUP Shop's discount rental passes! 🌊 Whether you're kayaking through the calm waters or paddleboarding beneath the sun, you'll love the stunning scenery and peaceful vibes of Marina del Rey. Each pass includes access to our local favorite, Marina del Rey’s Original Sunset Paddle Cruise on Wednesday nights, giving you the perfect mid-week escape. Simply purchase your pass online, receive a single code, and book your rentals online anytime using your unique code—your passes never expire! Perfect for frequent paddlers, each pass is for individual use, with one rental per day. Life really is better on the water. 🛶

services.name: Beginner Private Lesson
services.desc: Learn the basics of stance, paddle strokes, rules & safety. We offer beginner lessons for new paddlers looking to learn the basics with a certified instructor. During your lesson, our goal is for you to be confident paddling around the Marina del Rey Harbor. You will learn the basics of stance, paddle strokes, recovery and safety. Practice the skills and see the sights of our local marina. Time: 9:00am and 11:00am 7 days a week. 24 hour advanced reservation

services.name: Intermediate Private Lesson
services.desc: Designed for paddlers who are comfortable on their board and looking to optimize their paddle technique. With a certified trainer. Time: 9:00am and 11:00am 7 days a week. 24 hours advanced reservation
